title: SYCP1 head-to-head assembly is required for chromosome synapsis in mouse meiosis.
authors: Billmyre, Katherine Kretovich; Kesler, Emily A; Tsuchiya, Dai; Corbin, Timothy J; Weaver, Kyle; Moran, Andrea; Yu, Zulin; Adams, Lane; Delventhal, Kym; Durnin, Michael; Davies, Owen Richard; Hawley, R Scott
one_liner_zh: 该文研究SYCP1蛋白头对头组装对小鼠减数分裂染色体联会的作用，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作（染色体联会）和分子动力学模拟，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟方法创新，仅作为边缘参考。
abstract: In almost all sexually reproducing organisms, meiotic recombination and cell division require the synapsis of homologous chromosomes by a large proteinaceous structure, the synaptonemal complex (SC). While the SC's overall structure is highly conserved across eukaryotes, its constituent proteins diverge between phyla. Transverse filament protein, SYCP1, spans the width of the SC and undergoes amino-terminal head-to-head self-assembly in vitro through a motif that is unusually highly conserved across kingdoms of life. Here, we report creation of mouse mutants, Sycp1(L102E) and Sycp1(L106E), that target SYCP1's head-to-head interface. L106E resulted in a complete loss of synapsis, while L102E had no apparent effect on synapsis, in agreement with their differential effects on the SYCP1 head-to-head interface in molecular dynamics simulations. In Sycp1(L106E) mice, homologs aligned and recruited low levels of mutant SYCP1 and other SC proteins, but the absence of synapsis led to failure of crossover formation and meiotic arrest. We conclude that SYCP1's conserved head-to-head interface is essential for meiotic chromosome synapsis in vivo.
abstract_zh: 在几乎所有有性生殖生物中，减数分裂重组和细胞分裂需要由大型蛋白质结构——联会复合体 (synaptonemal complex, SC)——介导的同源染色体联会。尽管SC的整体结构在真核生物中高度保守，但其组成蛋白在不同门类间存在差异。横向丝蛋白SYCP1跨越SC的宽度，并通过一个在生命界中异常高度保守的基序，在体外进行氨基端头对头自组装。在此，我们报告了靶向SYCP1头对头界面的小鼠突变体Sycp1(L102E)和Sycp1(L106E)的创建。L106E导致联会完全丧失，而L102E对联会无明显影响，这与它们在分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟中对SYCP1头对头界面的差异效应一致。在Sycp1(L106E)小鼠中，同源染色体对齐并招募低水平的突变SYCP1及其他SC蛋白，但联会的缺失导致交叉形成失败和减数分裂停滞。我们得出结论，SYCP1保守的头对头界面在体内对减数分裂染色体联会是必需的。
